mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.course_id, c.title, c.position, c.duration_min, c.is_preview AS preview, c.video_url, c.quiz_pass_percent, c.created_at, c.updated_at, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM quiz_questions q WHERE q.chapter_id = c.id) AS quiz_question_count FROM chapters c WHERE c.course_id = #{courseId} ORDER BY c.position, c.id

SELECT c.id, c.course_id, c.title, c.content, c.video_url, c.position, c.duration_min, c.is_preview AS preview, c.quiz_pass_percent, c.created_at, c.updated_at, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM quiz_questions q WHERE q.chapter_id = c.id) AS quiz_question_count FROM chapters c WHERE c.id = #{id}
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(position), 0) + 1 FROM chapters WHERE course_id = #{courseId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chapters (course_id, title, content, video_url, position, duration_min, is_preview) VALUES (#{courseId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{videoUrl}, #{position}, #{durationMin}, #{preview})
mapper.update: UPDATE chapters SET position = #{position} WHERE id = #{id} AND course_id = #{courseId}
